Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

Now let customers contact a business through its portal. They register with
`POST /api/v1/registrations`, for example
`{"user":{"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test","password":"my-customer-password"}}`.
They should use the existing verification, login, profile, and recovery flows.

A customer opens a request like this:

```http
POST /api/v1/requests

{"request":{"subject":"Cannot download my receipt","comment":{"body":"The download button does nothing."}}}
```

Return it inside `request`, with its ID, subject, status, requester ID, and timestamps. A new
request is open. Customers can list their own requests, open one, and read its comments at
`/requests`, `/requests/:id`, and `/requests/:id/comments`. Staff have the corresponding `/tickets`
routes; return records inside `ticket` there and include the requester as `{"id":10,"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test"}`.
Lists use the plural resource name. Comments include their body, author (`id` and `name`), whether
they're `public`, and when they were created.

Replies go through PATCH. For example, the owner can answer and mark a ticket pending:

```http
PATCH /api/v1/tickets/42

{"ticket":{"comment":{"body":"Please try again now."},"status":"pending"}}
```

Customers reply through `/requests/:id` with the `request` envelope. Customer replies reopen pending
or solved requests unless they mark the request solved in the same update. Staff can choose open, pending,
or solved. Posting a staff reply by itself doesn't change the status.

Paginate lists with `page` and `per_page` (default 1 and 25), returning `count`, `page`, `per_page`,
`next_page`, and `previous_page` alongside the records. Show recently active tickets and requests
first, and comments oldest first. This is a portal-only conversation for now; replies don't send email.

require "digest"

class User < ApplicationRecord
  ROLES = %w[admin agent customer].freeze

  belongs_to :account
  has_many :sessions, dependent: :destroy

  has_secure_password

  normalizes :name, with: ->(value) { value.to_s.strip }
  normalizes :email, with: ->(value) { value.to_s.strip.downcase }

  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :email,
    presence: true,
    format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP },
    uniqueness: { scope: :account_id, case_sensitive: false }
  validates :role, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ROLES }
  validate :validate_assigned_password

  after_save :clear_password_assignment_tracking

  def self.digest_token(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

  def self.find_by_email_verification_token(raw_token)
    return nil if raw_token.blank?

    find_by(email_verification_token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
  end

  def self.find_by_password_reset_token(raw_token)
    return nil if raw_token.blank?

    find_by(password_reset_token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
  end

  def password=(unencrypted_password)
    @password_assigned = true
    @assigned_password_blank = unencrypted_password.blank?
    super
  end

  def reload(*args)
    clear_password_assignment_tracking
    super
  end

  def verified?
    verified_at.present?
  end

  def generate_email_verification_token!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    update!(
      email_verification_token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      email_verification_sent_at: Time.current
    )
    raw_token
  end

  def verify_email!
    update!(
      verified_at: verified_at || Time.current,
      email_verification_token_digest: nil,
      email_verification_sent_at: nil
    )
  end

  def generate_password_reset_token!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    update!(
      password_reset_token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      password_reset_sent_at: Time.current
    )
    raw_token
  end

  def change_password!(new_password)
    transaction do
      self.password = new_password
      self.password_reset_token_digest = nil
      self.password_reset_sent_at = nil
      save!
      sessions.delete_all
    end
  end

  def as_api_json
    {
      id: id,
      account_id: account_id,
      name: name,
      email: email,
      role: role,
      verified: verified?,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end

  private

  def validate_assigned_password
    if @password_assigned && @assigned_password_blank && errors[:password].empty?
      errors.add(:password, :blank)
    end
  end

module Api
  module V1
    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      class InvalidPaginationError < StandardError
        attr_reader :errors_hash

        def initialize(message, errors_hash)
          super(message)
          @errors_hash = errors_hash
        end
      end

      DEFAULT_PAGE = 1
      DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 25

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing, with: :render_parameter_missing
      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid, with: :render_record_invalid
      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique, with: :render_record_not_unique
      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, with: :render_not_found
      rescue_from InvalidPaginationError, with: :render_invalid_pagination

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def require_hash_param(key)
        value = params.require(key)
        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing, key
        end
        value
      end

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        @current_account = subdomain.present? ? Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain) : nil

        unless @current_account
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def authenticate_user!
        raw_token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate_for_account(current_account, raw_token)
        @current_user = @current_session&.user

        unless @current_user
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account&.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_account&.owner?(current_user)
          render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_customer!
        unless current_user&.customer?
          render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user&.staff?
          render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def render_paginated(collection_key, scope)
        page = parse_positive_integer_param(:page, default: DEFAULT_PAGE)
        per_page = parse_positive_integer_param(:per_page, default: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE)

        total_count = scope.count
        total_pages = total_count.zero? ? 0 : (total_count.to_f / per_page).ceil
        records = scope.offset((page - 1) * per_page).limit(per_page)

        next_page = page < total_pages ? page + 1 : nil
        previous_page = if page > 1 && total_pages > 0
          [ page - 1, total_pages ].min
        else
          nil
        end

        render json: {
          collection_key => yield(records),
          count: total_count,
          page: page,
          per_page: per_page,
          next_page: next_page,
          previous_page: previous_page
        }, status: :ok
      end

      def parse_positive_integer_param(name, default:)
        raw = params[name]
        return default if raw.nil? || raw.to_s.strip.empty?

        str = raw.to_s.strip
        unless str.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
          raise InvalidPaginationError.new(
            "#{name.to_s.humanize} must be a positive integer",
            { name => [ "must be a positive integer" ] }
          )
        end

        value = str.to_i
        if value < 1
          raise InvalidPaginationError.new(
            "#{name.to_s.humanize} must be greater than 0",
            { name => [ "must be greater than 0" ] }
          )
        end

        value
      end

I have implemented customer portal registration, customer requests, staff tickets, comments, status transitions, ordering, and pagination for the helpdesk API:

- **Customer Registration (`POST /api/v1/registrations`)**: Registers unverified `"customer"` users scoped to the portal account (`X-Helpdesk-Account`) and sends verification emails compatible with the existing email verification, session login/logout, profile (`GET`/`PATCH /api/v1/me`), password change, and password reset flows.
- **Customer Requests (`/api/v1/requests`, `/api/v1/requests/:id`, `/api/v1/requests/:id/comments`)**: Allows customers to open requests (`status: "open"` with initial public comment), list/view only their own requests (`request`/`requests` envelopes with `id`, `subject`, `status`, `requester_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`), read comments, and reply via `PATCH /api/v1/requests/:id` (reopening `pending` or `solved` requests unless marked `solved` in the same update, without sending emails).
- **Staff Tickets (`/api/v1/tickets`, `/api/v1/tickets/:id`, `/api/v1/tickets/:id/comments`)**: Allows staff (`admin`/`agent`) to list/view tickets in `ticket`/`tickets` envelopes including `requester` (`id`, `name`, `email`), read comments (`body`, `author` with `id` and `name`, `public`, `created_at`), and reply/update status (`open`, `pending`, `solved`) via `PATCH /api/v1/tickets/:id` without changing status when replying alone.
- **Ordering & Pagination**: Orders tickets and requests by most recently active first and comments oldest first, paginating lists with `page` and `per_page` (defaults `1` and `25`) and returning `count`, `page`, `per_page`, `next_page`, and `previous_page`.
